tools.name: rayana_ai_rankings
tools.description:
Latest ranked candidate batch for a lane: daily (the main research
lane), turtle (breakout system), or mr (mean-reversion). Rows come back in
rank order, best first, so the default page is the top of the batch.

`total` in the response is the batch size; when it exceeds `count`,
later rows are reach

tools.name: rayana_ai_lanes
tools.description: Which lanes (daily/turtle/mr) currently have a batch available.

tools.name: rayana_ai_signals
tools.description:
Latest aggregator-consensus batch for one asset lane: which tickers
cleared the signal pipeline, blended agg_score, confirming source count.

tools.name: rayana_ai_consensus
tools.description:
Per-source consensus snapshots (insider trades, congressional trades,
earnings beats, dated catalysts, on-chain flows, 13F filings, AI
news-beneficiary reads). Omit `source` for every source at once, or
pass one of the slugs returned in a rankings/signals row's source list.

`limit` caps rows per so

tools.name: rayana_ai_ticker
tools.description:
Full per-ticker research view: score, lane membership, per-source
signals, virality, consensus, cluster-rotation position, forward returns.

tools.name: rayana_ai_ticker_price
tools.description:
Daily close-price history for one ticker over the given period.

Long periods are evenly sampled down to `max_points` bars rather than
cut short, so the series still spans the whole period — `5Y` and `MAX`
return the shape of the history, not its last year. `last_close`,
`change_pct` and the `range_

tools.name: rayana_ai_ticker_analyst
tools.description:
The ticker's current AI analyst read (lean, conviction, thesis, six
fixed sections, evidence for/against, invalidation condition). Never
triggers a new model call; 404s when the ticker has no current read.
Counts one read against the subscription's monthly allowance, once per
ticker per day; `rayana

tools.name: rayana_ai_analyst_read
tools.description:
Open a ticker's AI analyst read: the current one, or a new one generated
on the spot when the ticker has none (this can take about half a minute).
Each ticker opened counts one read against the subscription's monthly
allowance, once per day; re-opening it the same day is free. `quota`
reports reads

tools.name: rayana_ai_ticker_articles
tools.description: One ticker's published article history, newest first.

tools.name: rayana_ai_rotation
tools.description:
Cluster-rotation layer. `summary`: latest per-cluster RRG
quadrant/rank rows with deltas, plus the most recent quadrant-crossing
events (`days` controls the window both are computed over).
`laggards`: members trailing a firing cluster's leader. `discovered`:
unsupervised cluster-discovery cohorts th

tools.name: rayana_ai_trends
tools.description:
The attention leaderboard: latest virality snapshot ranked by VScore,
with the full intensity/breadth/slope/vramp decomposition.

tools.name: rayana_ai_trends_detail
tools.description:
The attention layer's raw texture. `sources`: per-source reach today.
`heat`: per-(ticker, source) attention contributions. `search`:
rising/breakout consumer search queries. `video`: rising video-view
velocity. `limit` applies to search/video only; omit it to use that
view's own default.

tools.name: rayana_ai_market_brief
tools.description:
The daily market brief: a generic engine-wide read with no
recommendations, descriptive only. Latest by default; pass
`date` (YYYY-MM-DD) for a specific day.

tools.name: rayana_ai_analyst_brief
tools.description:
The portfolio-analyst brief with its per-ticker views — the broadcast
opinion layer, identical for every caller.

tools.name: rayana_ai_portfolios
tools.description:
The full shelf of Rayana AI's broadcast model portfolios as
merchandising cards, with each card's tier/openable/delayed flags.

tools.name: rayana_ai_portfolio
tools.description:
One model portfolio's full detail: holdings, overlay legs, event feed,
NAV series, and windowed returns. Returns an error if the book's tier
(e.g. an Elite-only book) is above the caller's own subscription tier.

tools.name: rayana_ai_search
tools.description:
Resolve free text (ticker or company name) to known Rayana AI symbols,
best match first. Pure resolution — never accrues signal.

tools.name: rayana_ai_articles
tools.description:
The public articles feed, newest first, when `slug` is omitted; one
published article's full body when `slug` is given.

tools.name: rayana_ai_plans
tools.description:
Rayana AI's subscription tiers: price, rate limits, and what each tier
includes. Works without signing in or an API key.

The research tools on this server require the Pro tier or higher. Prices
are USD; annual billing is ten months' price for twelve.

tools.name: rayana_ai_start_checkout
tools.description:
Returns a subscription link for a tier, which the user opens in a
browser. Works without signing in or an API key. The tool itself takes no
payment: the user signs in, accepts the Terms of Service and pays on
Stripe's hosted checkout page.

Standard does not include access to this server's research
